title: Exodus Bible Quiz - Chapter 6
description: Ten questions on Exodus 6: God's promise to Moses and the family heads of Reuben, Simeon and Levi.

questions.text: As whom did God appear to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob?
questions.explanation: God says he appeared to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob as God Almighty, but by his name Yahweh he was not known to them.

answers.text: As the God of the Hebrews
As the Mighty One of Egypt

questions.text: Which land did God establish his covenant to give to the patriarchs?
questions.explanation: God established his covenant with them to give them the land of Canaan, the land in which they lived as aliens.

questions.text: Why did the children of Israel not listen to Moses?
questions.explanation: They didn't listen to Moses because of anguish of spirit and cruel bondage.

answers.text: Because of anguish of spirit and cruel bondage
Because they did not trust Aaron
Because Moses spoke in a foreign tongue

questions.text: What did Moses say about his lips?
questions.explanation: Moses said, "How then shall Pharaoh listen to me, when I have uncircumcised lips?"

answers.text: That they had been touched by fire
That they were sealed by God

questions.text: Which of these was a son of Reuben?
questions.explanation: The sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel, were Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron and Carmi.

questions.text: Who were the sons of Levi?
questions.explanation: The sons of Levi were Gershon, Kohath and Merari.

questions.text: Who were the parents of Aaron and Moses?
questions.explanation: Amram took Jochebed, his father's sister, as his wife, and she bore him Aaron and Moses.

questions.text: Whom did Aaron take as his wife?
questions.explanation: Aaron took Elisheba, the daughter of Amminadab and sister of Nahshon, and she bore him Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
The sons of Izhar were Korah, Nepheg and Zichri.

questions.text: Who was the father of Phinehas?
questions.explanation: Eleazar, Aaron's son, took one of the daughters of Putiel as his wife, and she bore him Phinehas.
